en: A vintage postcard-style image showing a nighttime or dusk panoramic view of a city in a valley surrounded by mountains. Above the city, a large white star shape contains a colorized romantic vignette of a woman and an Alpine soldier embracing, the soldier wearing a feathered hat typical of Italian Alpini troops. The city view itself is monochrome, while the couple and a flower in her hand are in color. At the bottom, in bright letters, is the word "TRENTO."
